title: Great soap dispenser! Easy foaming solution!
text: Great soap dispenser! Easy foaming solution!. I really like these bottles, they arrived fast and very well packaged, I did not see any scratches on them or anything, they are glass or fake glass as far as I'm concerned and a little heavy but they were super easy to use, they look really good and the foaming device works great, which I was a little concerned for after reading reviews on all other products and even a couple here as well but these work really great! I would totally recommend these they may not look so cute but they are alright, plus they are easy to clean and I like that they are transparent for some reason I like transparent things.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Refillable Glass Foaming Hand Soap Dispenser - Foam Soap Pump Bottle Container for Bathroom Counter Top - Decorative Foam Soap Dispenser - Malloy Collection - 6 Pack - Clear/Chrome
features: SAVE ON SOAP: This soap dispenser utilizes foaming soap to produce a rich lather while using less soap; Use a foaming soap refill mix or mix your own using 1 part soap and 5 parts water; If you want to add some fragrance to your foaming soap, a few drops of essential oils are all you need; For best results when making your own solution, use oil-based castile soap; Set of 6

GENEROUS CAPACITY: Each dispenser pump holds 12 ounces of foaming soap solution and is easy to refill with the removable pump head and wide mouth; To extend the life of your pump, add a few drops of olive oil to your soap before filling up the dispenser

A DISPENSER FOR EVERY SINK: Place foaming dispensers on bathroom vanity countertops or kitchen sinks to keep soap always at your fingertips; Also great for college dorm rooms, apartments, RVs, and more
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of glass with a durable plastic pump head; Designed for use in moisture-rich bathroom environments; EASY CARE: Clean with mild soap and water
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Each Measures 3" diameter x 8" high; Holds 12 oz.
description: Stylishly store foaming soap on your bathroom or kitchen sink with this Foaming Soap Dispenser from mDesign. The dispenser holds twelve ounces of foaming soap solution and is easily refillable with the removable pump head and wide mouth. Simply combine one part liquid soap with five parts water or use a foaming soap solution. The modern design makes a stylish statement that flows well with any decor. Modern living by design.
